_about: Published error-rate figures for named AI detectors. Every entry names its source. 'checked' records how far this project verified it: 'primary' = read in the primary source; 'summary' = seen only via a search summary or secondary report; 'vendor' = the detector's own claim. Detectors change models silently: a figure describes the version that was tested, on the text that was tested. Last reviewed 2026-11-21.
